pictures.name: morning_over_a_quiet_land
pictures.scene: a wide green country taking the first clear light of the morning, the near hedges and grass lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the far hills and sky above them soft and pale and calm

pictures.name: stream_running_all_day
pictures.scene: a small stream running steadily over clean gravel in full daylight, the moving water lit bright and warm at the bottom of the frame, the shaded bank above it green and dim and altogether unhurried

pictures.name: broken_reed_staff
pictures.scene: a fine painted staff snapped clean through and lying in two pieces on the ground, the splintered break lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the bare floor above it dull and grey and empty

pictures.name: dry_grass_returning_to_dust
pictures.scene: a patch of pale withered grass crumbling back into bare dust, the brittle stems lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the dry ground beyond them running away flat and colourless and still

pictures.name: deep_rooted_oak_on_the_ridge
pictures.scene: one broad oak standing firm on an exposed ridge with its roots gripped deep into rock, the trunk lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the heavy canopy above it dark against a pale sky

pictures.name: sea_and_sky_meeting
pictures.scene: an enormous calm sea meeting an enormous clear sky at one long level line, the near swell lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the whole depth above it open and blue and entirely empty

pictures.name: bread_set_out_on_a_plain_table
pictures.scene: round loaves and a bowl of lentils set out ready on a plain wooden table, the nearest bread lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the simple room above and behind it brown and quiet

pictures.name: struck_shackle_lying_open
pictures.scene: an iron shackle struck open and lying loose on a stone floor with its pin beside it, the metal lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it dim and rough and holding nothing

pictures.name: unloaded_pack_frame
pictures.scene: a wooden pack frame set down empty against a wall with its straps hanging slack, the worn timber lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and dim and deep in shade

pictures.name: tent_with_its_flap_tied_open
pictures.scene: a dark goat hair tent pitched beside a track with its entrance tied wide open and a warm light inside, the near ground lit low and gold, the evening country above and beyond it quiet and blue

pictures.name: hill_city_in_steady_light
pictures.scene: a walled city on a hill standing in even unchanging daylight, the lower terraces lit warm and clear along the bottom of the frame, the walls and the sky above them pale and settled and very calm

pictures.name: broad_valley_in_full_sun
pictures.scene: a wide green valley opened out under full midday sun, the near meadow and stream lit bright and warm at the bottom of the frame, the far slopes above them soft and blue and altogether at rest

pictures.name: high_cloud_lit_gold
pictures.scene: tall banks of high cloud lit gold from beneath by a low sun, the dark land lying quietly across the bottom of the frame, the great sky above it deep and luminous and slowly changing colour

pictures.name: last_light_across_the_hills
pictures.scene: the very last of the sun running gold along a long line of hills, the near pasture lit warm and low, the ridges and the sky above them deepening quietly into an immense and settled evening blue

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD, O my soul.
I will praise the LORD all my life;
I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
Put not your trust in princes,
in mortal man, who cannot save.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground;
on that very day his plans perish.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob,
whose hope is in the LORD his God,
the Maker of heaven and earth,
the sea, and everything in them.
He remains faithful forever.
He executes justice for the oppressed
and gives food to the hungry.
The LORD sets the prisoners free,
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind,
the LORD lifts those who are weighed down,
the LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD protects foreigners;
He sustains the fatherless and the widow,
but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
The LORD reigns forever,
your God, O Zion, for all generations.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
